Relocating or compensating people implies communication or dialogue with them and with other

relevant stakeholders. The consultation and participation process will include four phases: (i)

specific PAP data collection; (ii) preparation and planning of operations; (iii) implementation /

execution of operations; and (iv) monitoring and evaluation. The PCU will coordinate all four

operations.

The PCU will coordinate the role of actors in the data-collecting phase. This process will include

a survey to specifically identify PAP for each subproject the bank approves for financing

followed by consultations with PAPs identified and other relevant stakeholders especially the

MOW, MOHLCD and project engineers together with PAPs about the extent of affect of the
